new_components: Admin XianyuDispatchBackfillDialog: bounded local-history form for actual device, logistics, ship time, reason, validation, submit state, warning, and completion event.
Backend XianyuOrderDispatchBackfillReqVO: validated typed request for the local-only backfill endpoint.
reused_components: Admin order table, permission directive, Element Plus dialog/form/input/date/alert/description components, useI18n, and useMessage.
Admin src/api/rental/xianyu.ts typed request transport and XianyuOrderShipRespVO response.
RentalDeviceAssignmentService for assignment and occupied schedule creation.
RentalDeviceOpsService.dispatch for AVAILABLE/ASSIGNED to RENTED/DISPATCHED transition.
Existing rental:xianyu:ship permission and tenant context.
extraction_triggers: Do not extract a shared backfill hook or form for a single admin use site.
If a future staff or second admin surface reuses the same form/state machine, extract a same-client reusable form and idempotent submit guard in that future change.
If multi-item allocation is added, extract explicit order-item selection policy rather than extending first-item behavior implicitly.
forbidden_dependencies: XianyuDispatchBackfillDialog must not call a raw HTTP client, XianGuanJia endpoint, backend Mapper, or implement device/schedule rules.
The backfill service path must not call XianyuWriteClient, XianyuWriteEndpoint, or XianyuRuntimeConfigService.getCurrent.
The backfill path must not require physical scanner, browser camera, uni-app, or staff-app code.
Frontend status visibility must not replace backend eligibility validation.
No new table, migration, role, permission code, or XianGuanJia write operation may be introduced.
hooks: No new shared hook; the dialog owns its local form, loading state, and per-open idempotency key.
utilities: Dialog-local date-time normalization formats existing or current local time as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
Existing WaybillPrivacy remains authoritative for masked waybill responses.
services: XianyuRentalConversionService converts an unmapped channel order using the selected device model.
RentalDeviceAssignmentService creates/reuses assignment and occupied schedule.
RentalDeviceOpsService dispatches the selected device locally.
required_component_tests: Backend: successful local backfill persists ADMIN_BACKFILL evidence, assignment/dispatch/delivery, updates consign fields, and calls neither runtime write config nor XianyuWriteClient.
Backend: pending, refunded, cancelled, and closed orders are rejected before mutation.
Backend: identical idempotent replay returns existing result; mismatched key reuse and same-waybill different-device cases return typed conflicts.
Backend: existing DISPATCHED plus RENTED assignment is reused without another dispatch.
Backend: unmapped order conversion, non-shippable device, cross-tenant shop, and transaction rollback paths are covered.
Admin: action visibility is limited to status 21/22 plus permission; dialog validation, loading, error preservation, success close, and list refresh are covered.
Admin: light/dark and zh-CN/en visual states are verified for desktop and narrow layouts.
